description: This file is a TypeScript source code for a test runner script that manages LLM autocompletion tests, including executing tests, generating reports, and cleaning approval files.

classes.name: TestResult
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of a test result, including approval status, timing, and error info.

classes.name: TestRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for running tests, generating reports, and cleaning approval files.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a single test case using a GhostProviderTester and checks approval.

methods.name: isUnknownResult
methods.description: Determines if a test result is unknown based on approval status and output.

methods.name: runAllTests
methods.description: Runs all test cases, possibly multiple times, and outputs a summary.

methods.name: printSummary
methods.description: Prints a summary report of all test results, including pass/fail counts and category breakdown.

methods.name: runSingleTest
methods.description: Runs a specific test case multiple times and outputs detailed statistics.

methods.name: cleanApprovals
methods.description: Removes approval files for test cases that no longer exist.
